description: Books a free on-site walkthrough at a time from list_walkthrough_slots, on behalf of the person you are helping. Confirm the time and every detail with them before calling. The office is emailed, and a confirmation goes to the email given. Status "booked" means it is on the calendar; "requested" means the office will call to confirm; "unavailable" means pick another slot.

approx_sqft.description: Approximate office size in square feet, if known.

city.description: Office city; must be in the service area.

email.description: Contact email; the confirmation is sent here.

notes.description: Anything the crew should know: cleaning frequency wanted, access, special areas.

slot_start.description: The exact "start" value of a slot from list_walkthrough_slots.

name: book_walkthrough
title: Book a walkthrough
